comment: Reviewed decisions for the daily trainer slots. Every beaten trainer is placed somewhere in its range each day: its class group (default), a place-type group, or its own slot (home). Each free slot is empty with its absence chance (default_absence_percent; 0 means someone is always there). not_daily_* force a trainer out of the daily slots with a reason; class_aliases merge trainer classes into one family; absence lists per-trainer absence chances; dialogue lists the resolution of every trainer the dialogue audit flags.
